title: Tesseract: self-replicating code organisms that evolve their own attention layers
description: An artificial-life system in which each organism is a file that carries its own genome: an arithmetic expression, or a small transformer with its weights, architecture and replay memory. Organisms earn energy on a Mandelbrot-set habitat, reproduce with mutation, prey on foreign neighbours, and grow new attention layers through a function-preserving morph. Includes control arms (random survival, a single brain trained alone) and a dependency-free self-replicating organism.
